issues.title: python-sc2 未安装，RealSc2BackendAdapter 仅用 MockBotAI 验证
issues.description: python-sc2 模块未安装（`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'python_sc2'`），RealSc2BackendAdapter 的协议和动作翻译测试使用 MockBotAI 替代真实 BotAI。虽然 MockBotAI 模拟了 BotAI 的关键接口（units/state/do_action/do），但真实 python-sc2 的 Units/Unit 对象有更多属性和方法，实际集成时可能需要调整翻译器。
issues.impact: RealSc2BackendAdapter 在真实 SC2 环境下的行为未验证；动作翻译器的参数传递（如 Point2/Point3 坐标转换）可能需要适配。
issues.workaround: 安装 python-sc2 后运行集成测试；或通过 launcher 启动真 SC2 并用 RealSc2BackendAdapter 驱动 BotAI

runtime_evidence.method: bypass python-sc2; use raw s2clientprotocol (sc_pb/raw_pb/common_pb) via AsyncSc2Client websocket to connect to SC2 launched by launch-cmre-alenger.ps1 -ApiMinimal -KeepAlive
runtime_evidence.result: PASS — raw API dispatch verified end-to-end: CreateGame + JoinGame + 30x(Step+Observation+Action). 5 commands succeeded (hold/stop/attack_move), 10 errors (invalid targets/self-target), 15 skipped (cast/morph/cancel not translated). 0 ScriptErrors.
key_findings: SC2 raw API (RequestCreateGame/RequestJoinGame/RequestStep/RequestObservation/RequestAction) works without python-sc2
Observation parsing requires obs_resp.observation.observation (ResponseObservation→Observation nesting), not obs_resp.observation directly
Minerals/vespene read from obs.player_common (PlayerCommon), NOT from raw.player (PlayerRaw)
ActionRawUnitCommand with target_world_space_pos=Point2D(x,y) is the correct protobuf structure for point-targeted commands
SC2 API auto-exits after ~40s if no client connects; must connect immediately after wait_for_api succeeds

issues.title: 真 SC2 启动 BankPoll/ChatCommand 不触发问题
issues.description: topics.md 记录：BankPoll/ChatCommand 触发器在 SC2 API 模式下不触发（state_version 保持 0）。这影响真 SC2 环境下的 RL 训练循环，因为动作分发依赖触发器机制。
issues.impact: 无法在真 SC2 上运行完整的 RL 训练循环；sim2real 评估退化为 SimulatorRlBackend + Mock 场景。
issues.workaround: 调查 SC2API RequestMapCommand 或 RequestDebug 作为替代传输方法（topics.md 建议）；或使用 launcher 的 overlay 机制绕过触发器限制

runtime_evidence.method: bypass BankPoll/ChatCommand triggers entirely by using raw SC2 API RequestAction with ActionRawUnitCommand (ability_id + unit_tags + target_world_space_pos/target_unit_tag)
runtime_evidence.result: PASS — 5 raw API actions successfully dispatched to SC2 (hold_units ability_id=18, stop_units ability_id=3665, attack_move_units ability_id=3674). SC2 returned result=1 (Success) for these. No triggers needed.
runtime_evidence.conclusion: BankPoll/ChatCommand trigger mechanism is NOT required for RL action dispatch. Raw RequestAction bypasses the trigger layer entirely, dispatching commands directly to units via the SC2 API protocol. This resolves ISSUE-010 for the raw-API-based RL runtime.

issues.title: FakeBackend 奖励与动作无关，无法验证 BC/PPO 任务收益
issues.description: Stage 01 的 FakeBackend 奖励仅来自观察转换（progress、supply、base_hp），与具体动作无关。因此 4 种策略（random_init/bc_pretrained/random_ppo/bc_ppo）的 mean_reward 完全相同（16.462），无法直接验证 BC 预训练或 PPO 训练在任务奖励上的提升。仅通过动作分布差异间接证明策略行为不同。
issues.impact: Stage 05 仅能验证 sim2real 评估流程跑通和策略行为差异，不能验证 BC/PPO 对任务奖励的实际贡献。
issues.workaround: 在 SimulatorRlBackend 完整 Dead-of-Night 场景（含敌人攻击、基地血量、夜波进度）上评估；或接入真 SC2 验证任务奖励

issues.title: SimulatorRlBackend 完整场景评估使用 MockSimulatorSession
issues.description: G3 测试使用 MockSimulatorSession（bypass Observation.from_world）而非真实 SimulatorSession。真实 SimulatorSession 需要加载 SC2 地图和 sc2_simulator 依赖，测试环境中不可用。
issues.impact: G3 仅验证 BC-pretrained policy 在 mock 模拟器上的 rollout 流程，不验证真实模拟器的物理/战斗逻辑。
issues.workaround: 在含 sc2_simulator 依赖的环境中运行真实 SimulatorSession 集成测试
